Round 4: burial 8 December 1712 in the parish index matches the tree.

bio: The San Mango parish burial index has the entry on 8 December 1712 ([R4-S1]), matching the tree's death date.
funFacts: The 1712 burial register is exceptional: 129 burials that year, 53 of them in December, against a normal 10-30 a year. Several of John's ancestors died in that wave.
